Updated `Parameter.get_error_hint` with keyword-only `include_secondary: bool = False`. Default behavior is preserved; `True` includes secondary options after primary options with the same formatting and fallback.

Only `src/click/core.py` changed; no untracked files remain.

arguments.command:
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'; @'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
import click
ctx = click.Context(click.Command('test'))
p = click.Option(['--enabled/--disabled', '-e/-d'])
for primary, secondary in [(['--enabled', '-e'], ['--disabled', '-d']), (['--enabled'], []), ([], ['--disabled']), ([], [])]:
    p.opts, p.secondary_opts = primary[:], secondary[:]
    for include in (False, True):
        expected = ' / '.join(repr(x) for x in ((primary + secondary if include else primary) or [p.human_readable_name]))
        assert p.get_error_hint(ctx, include_secondary=include) == expected
    assert p.get_error_hint(ctx) == ' / '.join(repr(x) for x in (primary or [p.human_readable_name]))
    assert p.opts == primary and p.secondary_opts == secondary
try:
    p.get_error_hint(ctx, True)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('include_secondary must be keyword-only')
print('Focused checks passed')
